title: Async checkpoint
prompt: Implement `static async ValueTask<int> ReadCachedAsync(int key, Func<int, Task<int>> slowFetch)`: a static ConcurrentDictionary<int,int> cache; on hit return synchronously WITHOUT awaiting (ValueTask fast path); on miss await slowFetch and store the result. Then implement `static async Task<string> WithTimeout(Task<string> work, TimeSpan timeout)` returning the work's result or throwing TimeoutException — using CancellationTokenSource with a timeout, and cancelling the linked token.

tests.name: cache-fast-path
tests.hint: TryGetValue first — return new ValueTask<int>(value) without touching the fetcher.

tests.name: timeout-fires
tests.hint: cts.CancelAfter(timeout); await task.WaitAsync(cts.Token) then translate OperationCanceledException to TimeoutException.
